# Qum

Qum is a Mac app that keeps prayer times, Qibla direction, silent reminders, and a personal prayer log in the MacBook notch. It supports English and Arabic.

- Home: https://hayyaqum.com/
- What Qum is: https://hayyaqum.com/about
- Frequently asked questions: https://hayyaqum.com/faqs
- Privacy: https://hayyaqum.com/privacy
- Terms: https://hayyaqum.com/terms
- Email: hello@hayyaqum.com

Requires macOS 14.6 or later and a MacBook with a built-in notch: MacBook Pro models introduced in 2021 or later, or MacBook Air models introduced in 2022 or later. It is not designed for external displays or closed-lid use.

The current version displays silent prayer reminders. It does not include adhan recordings or playback controls. Qum must be running to show the prayer panel. Confirm prayer acknowledges the reminder; the later check-in records prayer completion.

Qum has no developer-hosted account or prayer-history service. Prayer history stays on your Mac. Apple handles location and place-search requests, and macOS manages local notifications. Website hosting and support email process requests and messages separately. Read the Privacy Policy for data handling and retention details.

Qum is not an iPhone app or a menu-bar timer. It uses the MacBook notch.

No Mac can measure heading. Qum calculates the Qibla bearing for your location and uses sun calibration to relate it to your desk. Recalibrate whenever you move or rotate your Mac.
